plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.name: AI
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.description: Provide OpenAI-compatible AI capabilities to Typecho-CF plugins.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.config.provider: Configure one or more OpenAI-compatible upstream providers and their models.
Complete public HTTPS API root, for example https://api.openai.com/v1.
Optional public model name. When set, the upstream name is not accepted as an alias.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.config.http.bas: Site-relative path. The endpoint is exposed below this path under /v1.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.config.http.tok: Bearer tokens allowed to call the endpoint. Delete every token to make the endpoint unreachable.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.provider-: Provider names must be at most {max} characters.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.base-url-: Provider {name} has an overly long base URL.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.api-key-t: Provider {name} has an overly long API key.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.model-nam: Model names and aliases in provider {name} must be at most 256 characters.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.base-url-: Provider {name} must use a public HTTPS base URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.model-ali: Model alias {model} is duplicated within provider {name}.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.chat-mode: Chat model {model} in provider {name} must support text modality.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.http-base: HTTP base path must be a site-relative path without query, fragment, or traversal segments.
plugin.typecho-plugin-ai.error.http-toke: Access tokens must be 16-128 characters using letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.
At most {max} access tokens are allowed.
